cases.name: legal

files.ok.md:
# Legal fences

```csharp
int value = 1;
```

```
no language at all
```

```csharp title="Example.cs" hl_lines="1 2"
int spaced = 2;
```

~~~python
value = 3
~~~

Prose may say ```csharp,ignore``` is wrong without being wrong itself, and a
fenced body may contain commas:

```text
one, two, three
```
